topic: Prison Reform De Carceration and Undertrial Rights Bill

findings.title: Bhim Singh v. Union of India (2015) 13 SCC 605
findings.limitations: Supreme Court directive mandating implementation of Section 436A CrPC for release of undertrials completing half or one-third maximum sentence.

gaps: Absence of a mandatory statutory prison capacity cap (100% threshold) and automatic personal bond release without financial surety for impoverished undertrials.
